verdict.rationale: A keyless runtime probe confirmed that https://learn.chatgpt.com/llms.txt returns a docs index with a dedicated '## Dots' section listing every dots page. Each page is fetchable as raw markdown by appending .md, and the earlier docs-md 404 came from appending .md twice. An agent can therefore be pointed straight at llms.txt and markdown docs for dots. Missing for 10: a dots-specific llms.txt (the index is shared and headed '# Codex'), and independent community corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: returned the vendor's docs index with a dedicated '## Dots' section listing every dots doc page
